title: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves
summary: Adds Cold to unarmed hits and grants an upcast Ice Knife.

fields.Chilling Strike: Unarmed hits deal an extra 1d4 Cold.
fields.Ice Knife: Level 3, Action once per Long Rest. Ranged spell attack within 60 ft for 1d10 Piercing on hit. The shard explodes even on a miss, dealing 4d6 Cold in its radius unless targets succeed on a Dexterity save, and creates Ice in a 7 ft radius. Usable while Silenced.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
